IncidentBot: *INCIDENT:* 3309871234 — SouthportCorp / southport-prod (VPC + dedicated pool) — partial observability blackout for tenant 'southport-prod'. Symptoms: ~30% of inference requests return no spans, downstream logs not delivered to tenant log silo. Paging @Maya (oncall).

Maya: ack, looking.

Maya: initial customer report? did they see errors or just missing traces/logs?

Southport SRE: They see normal inference responses but when they try to correlate to their traces there are gaps. Some requests have only root span, no child spans. We also can't see logs for 1 of 3 API pods. Happening since ~09:12 UTC.

Tilly (SRE): any recent deploys to forwarder/bridge? forwarding tokens rotated last night? @Elaine?

Elaine (Observability): checking metrics now. There is a spike in forwarder 401s for tenant id=sp-001 around 09:11:05. Also one metric shard reported `partition_unavailable` for dedicated-pool-3.

Elaine (Observability): logs snippet from forwarder:
```
2026-03-15T09:11:04Z forwarder[pod=fw-23] tenant=sp-001 level=warn msg="forwarder request failed" status=401 err="invalid token"
2026-03-15T09:11:05Z forwarder[pod=fw-23] tenant=sp-001 level=info msg="token refresh attempt" result="kms-denied"
```

Jon (Infra): so forwarder token refresh failing against KMS. Is this the customer-managed KMS or our managed key for dedicated pools?

Elaine (Observability): It's the customer KMS (VPC). Looks like the forwarder tried to rewrap the ephemeral forward token and KMS responded deny. This would cause the forwarder to stop sending tenant traces and logs to the customer's sink.

Maya: impact classification? only traces/logs for this tenant, not serving traffic? (need for pager/esc)

Southport SRE: Serving unaffected. We need traces/logs for debugging and audits. Customer on-call is watching.

Maya: OK this is P2 customer-impacting observability (tenant isolation). Triage steps: 1) verify forwarder pods and token state, 2) attempt to requeue failed batches, 3) if KMS denies persist, enable temporary proxy to reforward to our managed relay while we sort KMS policy with customer.

Tilly (SRE): I'm going to `kubectl exec` into `fw-23` and check the token file and forwarder status. Will report back in 3m.

Tilly (SRE): run output:
```
# kubectl -n infra exec -it fw-23 -- cat /var/run/forwarder/token
status: expired
wrapped_by: kms://projects/southport/keyring/key1
```

Tilly (SRE): token expired + KMS wrap failing. I can rotate local ephemeral token to get flow for a short window but it will rewrap in ~5m and fail again.

Jon (Infra): I can stand up a relay proxy that accepts the forwarder stream and re-signs with a Redwood-managed key temporarily (we have approval for emergency mitigations). That removes the customer KMS dependency while we work the policy with Southport KMS admins.

Southport SRE: Would prefer we keep data in their VPC / retention rules. If you proxy to Redwood-managed, we need written consent. We can do a targeted replay of missing spans only if you can guarantee access controls.

Maya: noted — I'll get written consent from the customer rep on call. For now we can run demo proxy but keep it disabled until we have signoff. Meanwhile, Tilly, can you `kubectl logs` fw-23 and dump failed batch IDs? We can replay them later.

Tilly (SRE): pulled failed batch ids: [b-9931, b-9932, b-9937]. Also found `forwarder.replay.queue` with size 18.

Elaine (Observability): we can reingest those batches via the debug proxy endpoint: `POST /debug/replay` with body "{\"batch_ids\": [...]}". We'll need the raw payload. If we rotate local token now, we can drain them to the proxy target (once set).

Jon (Infra): prepping the proxy. Quick command to stand up on infra host:
```
# start-relay --tenant sp-001 --listen 0.0.0.0:18080 --sign-key /opt/keys/temp-redwood.pem
```

Jon (Infra): firewall rule needs 18080 allow from infra nodes; infrabot is opening now.

InfraBot: firewall change applied: allow tcp/18080 from infra-subnet.

Maya: customer approved temporary proxy if scope limited to replay only and no retention changes. Southport SRE: please confirm here in channel. @Southport SRE

Southport SRE: confirmed for replay-only. Keep retention/permissions unchanged. We'll monitor.

Tilly (SRE): rotating local ephemeral token now to drain the queue into the proxy. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra exec fw-23 -- /bin/forwarder rotate-token --ttl=10m --target http://10.8.5.12:18080/debug/ingest
```

Tilly (SRE): rotation accepted, draining replay queue. Seeing HTTP 200 on replay items.

Elaine (Observability): new spans coming in for southport-prod. Sampling looks sparse; setting `sampling.override=verbose` for next 30m to capture full traces for validation. Pushing config now.

Elaine (Observability): pushed. We see child spans reappearing; latency traces are backfilled for b-9931..b-9937.

Southport SRE: we can see the backfilled traces, thanks. logs still missing for one API pod; looks like log forwarder on that pod is stuck with the same token issue.

Jon (Infra): I'll rotate token for the log forwarder pod as well (fw-log-9) and trigger a small restart to force rewrap.

Jon (Infra): done. fw-log-9 restarted, logs flowing again.

Maya: status update for product: tenant traces/logs partially restored via proxy + token rotation. Root cause: customer KMS denied token rewrap leading to per-tenant forwarder stall. Work remaining: 1) coordinate with Southport KMS admin to fix rewrap policy, 2) schedule controlled failover to customer-managed KMS after fix, 3) audit replay to ensure no duplicates.

Southport SRE: we've scheduled a call with our security team at 09:50 UTC to review KMS policy. We'll share needed ACLs.

Maya: I'll prepare the post-incident checklist and timeline. For now, I'm handing off monitoring to Jon (Infra) for the next 2h while I brief customer and finish RCA notes.

Jon (Infra): taking over. Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/tenants/sp-001/observability

Jon (Infra): will keep sampling override for 30m and watch for duplicate spans. If duplicates exceed 0.1% we'll pause replay and apply dedupe.

Maya: thanks — sending formal handoff to oncall channel. @Tilly, @Elaine, please stay on standby for the call at 09:50.

Tilly (SRE): standing by.

Elaine (Observability): I'll generate a short snapshot of affected batch IDs and time windows for the RCA.

Southport SRE: thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast action. We'll wait for the KMS folks on the call.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT 3309871234 UPDATED: Mitigation in place — temporary proxy + replays; owner: Jon (Infra); state: monitoring. Severity downgraded to P3. Ticket: https://redwood.incidents/3309871234

Maya: handing off to Jon. last_note: proxy up, 18 queues drained, 3 batches replayed. continue monitoring and do not enable proxy for any other tenant without written approval.

Jon (Infra): acknowledged, taking over. will update in 15m.
